summary: An online world for children where you played as a cartoon penguin, chatted with friends and decorated your igloo. More than 200 million accounts were made.

events.note: Club Penguin opens to the public.

events.label: Disney
events.note: Disney buys the company for $350 million.
Club Penguin closes and is replaced by an app, Club Penguin Island.

cause: Disney closed it in favour of a phone app.
